coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: 目 eye + 少 here a variant of 生# (slender grass shoots) → narrow the eyes in observing (compare 睜) → *inspect minutely* → *ponder*; *inquire*; *confirm*. *Reduce* and *omit* are borrowed meanings → *governmental office*; *unit of an administrative district* (← local authority of reduced/lesser power ← centralized power of the ruler).
視也。从眉省，从屮。
眂皃。从目氏聲。

丏# is a variant of 正 straight, the curving line suggesting the idea of obscurity (← curved object that eludes direct observation) → bend; oblique. 眄 adds 目 eye → view obliquely → *look sidelong at*; *look the other way*.
目偏合也。一曰衺視也。秦語。从目丏聲。
多白眼也。从目反聲。《春秋傳》曰：“鄭游眅，字子明。”
As per 少# (small/slight) + 目 eye → have/make one eye smaller than the other, obscuring sight → *squint*; *be blind in one eye*.
一目小也。从目从少，少亦聲。
As per 冘# as described in 沈 (sink) + 目 eye → *fasten one's eyes on* (allow the eyes to sink into) an object → *stare*; *glare*. Compare 覘.
視近而志遠。从目冘聲。《易》曰：“虎視眈眈。”
A depiction of a long, curved *eyebrow* covering an eye → *eyebrow-shaped object*.
目上毛也。从目，象眉之形，上象頟理也。凡眉之屬皆从眉。

As per 毛# (fine objects) + 目 eye → object too fine to be seen clearly → *dim-sighted* → *eye lacking sparkle*. Also, (mentally dull/senile) *elderly person* (← overall physical decline ← decline in vision). Compare 瞀.
目少精也。从目毛聲。《虞書》耄字从此。
手 hand + 目, here an abbreviated form# of 見 fix sight upon → hand affixed above the eye to shade it and improve focus → *see*; *watch*.
睎也。从手下目。

A depiction of an upside-down, severed head (compare 首), which it was a custom to *suspend in midair* from a high place (to serve as a warning to potential criminals). In Japan, 県 was also adopted as a Shinjitai (new character form) to replace 縣, according to which 県 also conveys the meanings *hang suspended in-between* and *prefecture*.
視高皃。从目戉聲。讀若《詩》曰“施罛濊濊”。
目相及也。从目，从隶省。
目有所恨而止也。从目㐱聲。
直視也。从目台聲。
目病生翳也。从目生聲。
As per 未# (obscure) + 目 eye → *obscure* and barely/not at all visible → *dark*; *blind*.
目不明也。从目未聲。
目不明也。从目末聲。
長眙也。一曰張目也。从目宁聲。
匕 double-pronged eating implement + an abbreviated form# of 鼎 tripod kettle/cauldron → fill a vessel by ladling things into it → *truth*; *essence* (← fully real; compare 實) → *reality*.
僊人變形而登天也。从𠤎从目从乚；(音隱。)八，所乘載也。
As per 民# (blind) + 目 eye → eyes blind in *sleep* → *sleepy*.
目無明也。从目夗聲。
目不正也。从目失聲。
As per 此# (line up irregularly) + 目 eye → (irregularly shaped) *corner of the eye(s)*.
目匡也。从目此聲。
乏# limited + 目 eye → quick *wink*. Compare 睫.
動目也。从目乏聲。
玄# obscure + 目 eye → be *dizzy* (← condition in which vision is obscured) → *dazzling*. Also, *confused*.
目無常主也。从目玄聲。
深目也。亦人姓。从目圭聲。
吳楚謂瞋目、顧視曰眮。从目同聲。
艸入目中也。从目米聲。
As per 旬# (cycle/circle) + 目 eye → take *a quick glance* all about (compare 睍) → *be dazzled*; *give someone a meaningful look*.
目傷眥也。从目多聲。一曰瞢兜。
As per 匡# (extend within a framing object) + 目 eye → eye extending over its *eye socket* → *eyelid*. Compare 窅.

As per 𠔉# as described in 券 (wrap/roll up) + 目 eye → take a panoramic/wraparound view of one's surroundings (compare 観) → *look back* → *take an interest in*; *take care of* (← keep a watchful eye on).
顧也。从目𢍏聲。《詩》曰：“乃眷西顧。”
As per 牟# (lowing cow) + 目 eye → *pupil* of a cow's eye.
目童子也。从目牟聲。《說文》直作牟。
目精也。从目灷聲。案：勝字賸，皆从朕聲。疑古以朕爲眹。

As per 兆# (split) + 目 eye → split a field of vision in staring/gazing over a vista → *stare/gaze at*; *look (out) over* → *look at/about*; *vista/view/prospect*. Also, *command a view of* and *consider*.
目不正也。从目兆聲。
As per 艮# (adhere) + 目 eye → *eye* (fixed upon an object; compare 見 and 臣).
目也。从目𥃩聲。
Abbreviated form# of 脈 (concealed) + 目 eye → the eyes (all but) concealed in squinting/gazing → *gaze*.
目財視也。从目𠂢聲。
多也。从乑、目，衆意。

眾.explanation: Graphical variant for “crowd; many”; the 2013 mainland appendix places 眾 in the orthographic-variant column (the common form in many traditional regions).
眾.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix row directly checked for classification; lexical equivalence is not a context-free replacement.

衆.explanation: Traditional-column form of 众 in the 2013 mainland appendix; same ordinary “crowd; many” meaning as 眾.
衆.evidenceScope: 2013 appendix row directly checked for classification; lexical equivalence is not a context-free replacement.

entries.text: Originally the same character as 著. When 著 came to refer to literary works, 着, a variant of 著 in popular usage, took over the meanings it presently expresses. As with 著, *adhere* and *meet with* are via the "pile" concept behind 者. The many extended meanings include *wear*, *put on* and *dress* (← clothing attached to the body), *be seated/take up a position* and *arrive/reach* (a destination) → *reach (to)*; *counter* (for clothes, or to enumerate the order of finishers in a race ← wear clothing; arrive); *cover* and *pin responsibility on*.
大目也。从目旱聲。
As per 完# (surround completely) + 目 eye → eyeball surrounded by its socket → *protruding eyeball*. *Bright* is a borrowed meaning.
As per 弟# (vertical alignment) + 目 eye → *look down* (at/upon); *lower the eyes* → *steal a glance at*.
目小視也。从目弟聲。南楚謂眄曰睇。
目小也。从目坐聲。
As per 肙# as described in 絹 (reel/unwind) + 目 eye → observe a scene that unwinds (= unfolds) before one's eyes → *look*; *see* → *look askance at*.
視皃。从目肙聲。
睌䁂，目視皃。从目免聲。
見# fix sight upon + 目 eye → goggle eyes → *stare* with eyes wide open. Also, take *a quick glance* all about (compare 眴).
出目也。从目見聲。
希# rare + 目 eye → *gaze* at/*yearn for* a rare object. Compare 望.
望也。从目，稀省聲。海岱之閒謂眄曰睎 。
暫視皃。从目炎聲。讀若白蓋謂之苫相似。
目大也。从目、侖。《春秋傳》有鄭伯睔。
目疾視也。从目易聲。
目驚視也。从目袁聲。《詩》曰：“獨行瞏瞏。”
厓 here a variant form of 圭# (neat) + 目 eye → neatly shaped eye → *eyelid*. Also, *stare/glare*.
目際也。从目、厓。
As per 靑/青# (clean/pure) + 目 eye → the (limpid) *pupil* of the eye.
爭# (long and thin) + 目 eye → narrow the eyes in observing (compare 省) → *observe*; *watch*.
目童子不正也。从目來聲。
As per 卒# (compact) + 目 eye → focus the eyes on a single object → be *clear-eyed*.
垂# hang + 目 eye → eyelids hung in sleep → *sleep*.
坐寐也。从目、垂。
As per 隹# (exert downward pressure) + 目 eye → *gaze up at* (← bowing/prostrate subordinate gazing up at a superior) → *gaze*; *stare*; *glare*.
仰目也。从目隹聲。
As per 叔# (slender and pendent) + 目 eye → watch over, the eyes figuratively hanging overhead → *supervise*; *command*. Compare 監 and 臨.
察也。一曰目痛也。从目叔聲。
卑# low + 目 eye → *glare* down upon → *stare*.
目 eye + 坴# as described in 陸 (stretch) → *cordial* gathering, the participants stretched in relaxation as they eye each other in a *friendly* atmosphere.
目順也。从目坴聲。一曰敬和也。
兒# infant(ile) + 目 eye → squint/*stare* like an infant → (sidelong) *glance*.
衺視也。从目兒聲。
目睞謹也。从目彔聲。讀若鹿。
An abbreviated form# of 直 (look directly at) + 幸 (handcuffed prisoners) → align prisoners in inspecting and picking them out → *inspect*.
目視也。从橫目，从㚔。令吏將目捕罪人也。
疌# as described in 倢 (nimble) + 目 eye → nimble winking/blinking of the *eyelashes*. Compare 眨.
大目出也。从目軍聲。
As per 者# (pile) + 目 eye → *look carefully/closely* at a pile of objects. A variant form, 覩, replaces 目 with 見 see while repositioning 者.
見也。从目者聲。
迎視也。从目是聲。讀若珥瑱之瑱。
As per 癸# (rotate) + 目 eye → *avert the eyes* (← rotate the eyes away from a person or object) → *separate*.
目不相聽也。从目癸聲。
A variant form of 皋 (waterside), specifying a *marsh*. *Testicle(s)* is a borrowed meaning.
As per 敄# as described in 務 (exertion) + 目 eye → strain the eyes, attempting to see an object clearly → *dim-sighted* → *dim-witted*. Compare 眊.
氐目謹視也。从目敄聲。
盾也。从盾犮聲。
As per 眞# (fullness) + 目 eye → *glare at* (← fully concentrate on the object of one's vision) → *be angry*.
張目也。从目眞聲。
As per 叟# (narrow/thin) + 目 eye → eye socket with only a thin scar, no eyeball → *blind*.
As per 害# (cut) + 目 eye → *one-eyed*; *blind (in one eye)* (← have one's vision partially cut). Also, *lie/fabrication* (compare English "a blind lie").
冥# darkness + 目 eye → *close one's eyes* and be plunged into *darkness*.
翕目也。从目、冥，冥亦聲。
平目也。从目㒼聲。
目孰視也。从目鳥聲。讀若雕。
開闔目數搖也。从目寅聲。
As per 㒼# as described in 滿 (cover completely) + 目 eye → figuratively cover another person's eyes (compare 冒 and 曼) in deceiving him → *deceive*; *cheat*. Compare 謾.
𥉻也。从目𤐫聲。
堂# (stretch) + 目 eye → *gaze* upon something distant (= figuratively stretch the eyes; compare 矕) → *stare*; *look*.
An abbreviated form# of 蔑 (obscured vision) + 目 eye (for emphasis/clarification) → *cloudy vision*; *dim-sighted*.
目不明也。从𥄕从䀏。䀏，目數搖也。
目動也。从目閏聲。
As per 敝# (split) + 目 eye → *cast a sideways glance (at)*.
過目也。又，目翳也。从目敝聲。一曰財見也。
目童子精也。从目喜聲。讀若禧。
深視也。一曰下視也。又，竊見也。从目覃聲。
As per 舜# (flame-like) + 目 eye → flame-like, rapid movement of the eyes in winking/blinking → *wink*; *blink* → *twinkle*; (in a) *flash*.
As per 尞# as described in 僚 (circular continuum) + 目 eye → *observe from a high place,* enjoying a *clear* panoramic view → *clear-sighted; *clarity*.

瞭.explanation: In understanding/seeing-clearly contexts, 瞭 is an optional traditional spelling in Taiwan; Taiwan MOE accepts both 了解 and 瞭解. The grammatical particle 了 is unchanged.
瞭.example: 了解 → 了解 / 瞭解 (both accepted in Taiwan); 吃了 → 吃了 (Taiwan writing uses 吃; 喫了 is an older form seen in OpenCC's basic conversion)
瞭.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.
瞭.usageCaveat: Do not require 了解→瞭解 as a universal replacement. The initial 吃/喫 distinction is independent of the grammatical particle 了.

lexicalEvidence.methodology: Exact version-pinned phrase records, with independently identified dictionary, composed-example or literary evidence where needed; no native OpenCC execution was performed.

supplementarySources.finding: Defines the completed-action particle le and illustrates it in 吃了再走.

attestedTargets.qualification: 吃了 is supported in Taiwan usage; the base OpenCC phrase row spells the first character 喫. Both spellings retain particle 了.

qualification.recommendation: Say 了解 may also be written 瞭解 in Taiwan; do not imply mandatory replacement. Particle 了 remains 了 in 吃了. Cite Taiwan dictionary evidence separately from the base OpenCC 喫了 record.

entries.text: 閒# gap + 目 eye → *peep*; *spy on* (← gaze through a gap in a wall).
戴目也。从目閒聲。江淮之間謂眄曰瞯。
As per 敢# (covered) + 目 eye → observe clandestinely, from a high spot → *spy*; *look*; *watch* (from above).
As per 童# (run through) + 目 eye → the *pupil* (originally, one run through in being blinded, the original sense of 童).
瞴婁，微視也。从目無聲。
目精也。从目粦聲。
As per 愛# (hinder) + 目 eye → hindered vision → *obscure*; *unclear* → *hide/hidden*.
As per 詹# (bear a burden) + 目 eye → (from the perspective of one stooping under the weight of a burden) *gaze*/*look* upward at another person.
臨視也。从目詹聲。
As per 僉# (assemble) + 目 eye → *eyelid* that assembles over (= covers) the eyeball.
目上下瞼也。从目僉聲。

鼓# drum + 目 eye → (blind) *musician* → *blind person*; *musical troupe*. Also, *illiterate* and *stupid* (← non-understanding ← blind). In ancient China, blind persons were commonly employed as court musicians.
目但有眹也。从目鼓聲。

目 eye (doubled)# is a character indicating "make a circular sweep with the eyes." 瞿 adds 隹 short, squat bird → bird looking about nervously (compare 雇 and 鶪) → *look about*; *stare at in surprise*; *be surprised and fearful*.
鷹隼之視也。从隹从䀠，䀠亦聲。凡瞿之屬皆从瞿。讀若章句之句。
大視也。从目蒦聲。
As per 蒙# (cover/conceal) + 目 eye → *blind* (and covered in ignorance) → *blind person* → *ignorant*.
童矇也。一曰不明也。从目蒙聲。
As per 賓# (contact) + 目 eye → *frown* or *scowl* (creating wrinkles on the brow in close contact). Compare 嚬 and 顰.
恨張目也。从目賓聲。《詩》曰：“國步斯矉。”
As per 瞿# (look nervously about) + 又 hand → bird enclosed in the hands, and looking nervously about, or in fright → *look about in fright, alarm or surprise*.
隹欲逸走也。从又持之，矍矍也。讀若《詩》云“穬彼淮夷”之“穬”。一曰視遽皃。
目多精也。从目雚聲。益州謂瞋目曰矔。
As per 䜌# as described in 戀 (stretch) + 目 eye → *observe carefully* (= stretch the eyes; compare 瞠) → *see*.
目矕矕也。从目䜌聲。
直# straight + a character doubling the same 直 element → tall/*luxuriant* vegetation → *towering*.
目無精直視也。从目黨聲。
屬# adhere + 目 eye → *watch carefully*, the eyes figuratively adhering to the object being watched.
A depiction of a halberd or *pike*, the base of the curved spearhead of which is covered and concealed in the shaft (compare 戊) → *arms*.
酋矛也。建於兵車，長二丈。象形。凡矛之屬皆从矛。
As per 今# (contain) + 矛 pike/halberd → *halberd handle* (in which the weapon is contained). *Be proud of*, *pity* and *piteous person* are borrowed meanings.
矛柄也。从矛今聲。
Here, 矛 pike/halberd is a variant of 戉# (scoop out). 矞 adds 冏 bright → use an instrument to scoop out or *bore* a circular hole, allowing *bright* light to penetrate.
以錐有所穿也。从矛从㕯。一曰滿有所出也。
As per 昔# (pile) + 矛 pike/halberd → *spear* with multiple heads (compare 矰) → *fishing spear* (compare 簎).
矛屬。从矛昔聲。讀若笮。
A depiction of a long, straight *arrow*. In the derivative characters 知 and 至, 矢 is presented as an arrow in flight toward its target.
弓弩矢也。从入，象鏑栝羽之形。古者夷牟初作矢。凡矢之屬皆从矢。

The relevant seal inscription form indicates an arrow hitting a squarish, lumpy target and coming to a stop. For the idea of stopping, compare 處 and 醫. 矣 was eventually employed as a *particle* indicating the completion of an action.
語已詞也。从矢以聲。
況也，詞也。从矢，引省聲。从矢，取詞之所之如矢也。

矢# arrow in flight + 口 mouth → knowledge allowing one to *speak to the essence of a matter* with the directness of an arrow in flight → *know*; *understand*; *realize*; *discover/notice* (the truth); *distinguish* (the truth) (← have the knowledge and insight to speak unerringly) → *intelligence* → *inform*; *notify*; *report*; *news*. Also, *omen* (← have advance knowledge of), *experience* and *feel* (← understand through experience and feeling) → *concern oneself*; *acquaintance* (← person one knows).
詞也。从口从矢。
春饗所䠶矦也。从人；从厂，象張布；矢在其下。天子䠶熊虎豹，服猛也；諸矦䠶熊豕虎；大夫射麋，麋，惑也；士射鹿豕，爲田除害也。其祝曰：“毋若不寕矦，不朝于王所，故伉而䠶汝也。”
引# draw/pull + 矢 arrow → hand drawing back an arrow → much/still more (← ever-increasing tension). In Japan however the character was applied to the verb はぐ (*feather an arrow*).

As per 巨# (large/great framing tool) + 矢 arrow (→ ancient measuring implement) → *carpenter's square* → *standard*. Compare also 榘 as described in 渠. For the use of 矢 to indicate a measuring implement, compare the original left-hand element of 規.
As per 豆# (a stand) + 矢 arrow → *short*, cylindrical stand for (long) arrows.
有所長短，以矢爲正。从矢豆聲。
As per 委# (hang low) + 矢 here an abbreviated form of 短 short → hang *low*; be *short* → *dwarf*. Compare 倭.
短人也。从矢委聲。
喬# tall and limber + 矢 arrow → *bend* a tall bow in firing off an arrow → *straighten*; *correct* (← bend back into shape) → *reform*.
揉箭箝也。从矢喬聲。
As per 曾# (pile) + 矢 arrow → *arrow* piled with arrowheads (compare 矠 and 簎), used for downing birds.
隿䠶矢也。从矢曾聲。

A depiction of a *rock* or *stone* beneath a cliff, suggesting a substantial pile of rocks/stones. *Sterile/barren* is by association (← rocky, barren soil), as is *rigid* (← rigid objects). *Unit of volume* is a borrowed meaning.
山石也。在厂之下；囗，象形。凡石之屬皆从石。
As per 乞# (rise and hit a blocking element) + 石 stone → lift stones in erecting an obstacle → *work hard*.
As per 工# (connecting pipe/tube) + 石 stone → *stepping stones* (connecting one bank of a river to the other; compare 杠) → *hard* (← hard stones) → *earnest*.
